messages.text: Happy to buy Palacio de Cristal at 54 primas, a fair price we can sign right now.
Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 101 P for this one.
Thanks! 101 is too high for me, but I can come up to 66 P for Palacio de Cristal.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 87 P, please?
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway at 82 P.
Thank you, we are getting close. 78 P works for me.
A real step from me: 70 P.
Thank you for your offer. I can move to 77 P.
Thanks, we're close. I can come up to 72 P.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 76 P, please?
We're very close now. Let's meet at 74 P and close it.
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway at 75 P.
